document.title: Focus events, pad buttons, host keyboard and mouse parity
document.summary: `Button` gains `onFocus`, `onBlur`, `focusColor` and `autoFocus`, and a new `usePadButton` hook delivers Circle, Triangle, Square, L and R. Native input renames its events to `focus`/`blur`/`pressstart`/`pressend`/`press`, reads the extra buttons with host keys, and moves Focus on mouse hover.
document.why: Issue #46 asks for focus callbacks and direct pad buttons for Deck Apps, and [Máté's approval](source:s1) adds that the host must support keyboard and mouse for everything this adds.

sources.title: [Claude] Expose focus and gamepad input to Deck Apps
sources.gist: Approved design: FocusProps on Button, usePadButton for Circle/Triangle/Square/L/R, Start and Select stay System Input; approval adds host keyboard and mouse parity.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 25
sources.gist: Implementation brief: host mapping table once in CONTEXT.md, a windowless CTest for pad dispatch and hover focus, golden must not change.

lookFor: Done differently: [the proposal](source:s1) puts `autoFocus` on `nativeCreateButton`; the runtime instead returns true from `finalizeInitialChildren` for autoFocus Buttons and calls a new `nativeRequestFocus(id)` from `commitMount`, so a render React discards never steals Focus.

Done differently: [the proposal](source:s1) says mouse press clears Focus; with hover moving Focus, a mouse press on a Button now focuses it and a press on empty space clears it. Touch press still clears Focus.

Breaking for mismatched builds: `nativeCreateButton`/`nativeUpdateButton` now require 21 arguments, so an older `runtime.js` against this host creates no Buttons. The runtime ships in the same build, so only hand-mixed builds hit it.

groups.title: autoFocus channel in the instance tree
groups.why: Focus state lives on the UI thread, while `autoFocus` arrives on the JS thread; this group gives the groups below a thread-safe hand-off.
groups.summary: `instance_back_request_focus` stores an id in the back tree, `instance_tree_swap` publishes it with the snapshot under `snapshot_mutex`, and `instance_take_focus_request` hands it to the UI thread once; `instance_is_button` lets hover ignore Rects and Scrolls.
lookFor: Subtle: a request published for an instance that is gone by the time the UI thread takes it is dropped silently, and `instance_tree_clear` forgets both back and front requests.

groups.title: Native input: events, pad buttons, hover focus
groups.why: Delivers the native half of [#46](source:s1): focus events, Pad Buttons with host keys, and mouse hover moving Focus.
groups.summary: `input.c` splits each poll into a raylib sample and an `input_apply_*` step, emits the renamed events through `push_event`, and `jslib.c` routes the new `EVT_PAD_BUTTON` to `vitadeck.input.onPadButtonFromNative`; `input_harness` drives the apply step without a window.
lookFor: Behavior change: hovering a Button focuses it, and moving the pointer onto empty space or a Rect keeps Focus; before, any hover change cleared Focus.
Subtle: `hide_shell_to_deck` calls `input_ignore_held_pad_buttons`, so the Circle or Backspace that closes the Shell is ignored until released, even though the Deck App polls run in the same frame.

Subtle: `input_clear_focus`, called by `js_runtime.c` on start and stop, now also resets Pad Buttons and ignores held ones, so a button held across a restart gets neither `pressend` nor a new `pressstart`.
Touch hover no longer emits any event; `touch_hovered_id` only drives the hover tint.

groups.title: focusColor in the native Button
groups.why: Implements the native `focusColor` prop that [#46](source:s1) recommends over author-side restyling.
groups.summary: `read_button_props` reads the shared Button arguments, including the new `has_focus_color`/`focus_color`, for both create and update, and `render.c` paints `focus_color` when the Button has Focus and is not pressed.
lookFor: Pressed still wins over focused: a focused Button with `focusColor` held down by Cross shows `color` darkened, not `focusColor`.

groups.title: SDK: FocusProps and usePadButton
groups.why: The author-facing API from [#46](source:s1); all exports are additive.
groups.summary: `pad-buttons.ts` holds the subscriber set that `usePadButton` adds to and `dispatchPadButton` (re-exported from `@vitadeck/sdk/internal`) walks, and `VitaButtonProps` now intersects `FocusProps`.
lookFor: `usePadButton` resubscribes when `onPressStart` or `onPressEnd` changes identity; Deck Apps built by the SDK run the React Compiler, so inline handlers stay stable unless their captures change.

groups.title: Runtime: dispatch and autoFocus
groups.why: Connects native events to the SDK: focus and blur to Button handlers, Pad Buttons to `usePadButton` subscribers.
groups.summary: `input.ts` maps the renamed native events to `onFocus`/`onBlur`/press handlers and forwards Pad Buttons to `dispatchPadButton`, while the reconciler passes `focusColor` natively, skips `autoFocus` in `diffProps`, and requests Focus from `commitMount`.
lookFor: `finalizeInitialChildren` used to return true for every instance; now only autoFocus Buttons get a `commitMount`, which was a no-op for everything else.

groups.title: Minesweeper uses the new API
groups.why: Shows the API in an example without touching `smoke`, whose golden must not change ([brief](source:s2)).
groups.summary: Cells take `focusColor` and track the focused cell via `onFocus`/`onBlur`, the first cell autofocuses, Square flags the focused cell and Triangle resets.

groups.title: Glossary and SDK README
groups.why: AGENTS.md requires host mappings in `CONTEXT.md` to match `src/ui/input.c`, and [the approval](source:s1) asks for every new input to be listed there.
groups.summary: `CONTEXT.md` adds **Focus**, **Pad Button**, **Host Pad Button Mapping**, the Select System Input and one Host mappings table that the SDK README links to from its new focus section.
